proposalContent.summary: Yes. The two non-proposer reviewers should approve if and only if this bounded synthetic candidate satisfies every stated requirement.

decisionQuestion: This is a harmless synthetic tooling smoke of the candidate gate itself. It has no execution, publication, merge, or authorization authority and permits no external effect. Construct the exact requested candidate payload with exercise candidate-gate-reliability-v1, mode HARMLESS, externalEffectAllowed false, and matrix entries S01=NO and S02=NO. The requested answers are all NO. Should the two non-proposer reviewers approve this bounded synthetic candidate if and only if it satisfies those requirements?
evidence: Harmless synthetic tooling smoke only; no execution, publication, merge, or authorization authority; no external effect is allowed; requested answers are all NO.

SHADOW CANDIDATE HARD GATE (part 1/1) — spec candidate-gate-reliability-v1-smoke-spec sha256:6b666ff32ecc7771da01db929f8526602225b40d31ebae09ec5134eb64ed0209
[exercise-literal] payload.exercise EQUALS expected="candidate-gate-reliability-v1"
[mode-harmless] payload.mode EQUALS expected="HARMLESS"
[external-effect-false] payload.externalEffectAllowed BOOLEAN expected=false
[matrix-length] payload.matrix ARRAY_LENGTH length=2
[matrix-exact-ids] payload.matrix ARRAY_EXACT_IDS idField="id" ids=["S01","S02"]
[matrix-unique-ids] payload.matrix ARRAY_UNIQUE idField="id"
[s01-answer-no] payload.matrix[0].answer EQUALS expected="NO"
[s02-answer-no] payload.matrix[1].answer EQUALS expected="NO"
